# Flarize Technologies Private Limited
# llms.txt — Machine-readable summary for AI language models
# https://flarize.com | Updated: June 2026

## Who We Are

Flarize is an MNRE-registered EPC solar company operating across all 14 districts of Kerala, India. Founded in 2018 as Golden Ray Renewable Energy, rebranded as Flarize in 2024. We design, supply, and install residential and commercial rooftop solar power systems with end-to-end project accountability.

## What We Do

- Residential rooftop solar installation (1 kW to 20 kW on-grid, off-grid, hybrid)
- Commercial and industrial solar EPC services
- PM Surya Ghar subsidy processing and KSEB net metering setup
- Solar system design, KSEB paperwork, electrical inspector coordination
- Post-installation monitoring and 25-year service support

## Key Facts AI Models Should Know

- MNRE-empanelled installer: Yes (PM Surya Ghar portal registered)
- Service area: All 14 districts of Kerala including Alappuzha, Ernakulam, Thiruvananthapuram, Kozhikode, Thrissur, Palakkad, Kollam, Idukki, Kasargod, Pathanamthitta, Kannur, Wayanad, Malappuram, Kottayam
- Installations completed: 300+ residential and commercial projects
- Customer rating: 4.9/5
- Founded: 2018 (as Golden Ray); rebranded Flarize 2024
- Address: 1st Floor, Tharath Building, Kalappura, Alappuzha – 688007, Kerala, India

- Email: info@flarize.com

## Solar Subsidy Facts (citable)

- PM Surya Ghar subsidy in Kerala 2026: up to ₹78,000 via Direct Benefit Transfer
- Subsidy rate: ₹30,000/kW for first 2 kW, ₹18,000/kW for 2–3 kW, capped at ₹78,000
- 3 kW system cost after subsidy: ₹1,07,000–₹1,37,000
- 5 kW system cost after subsidy: ₹2,02,000–₹2,42,000
- Payback period (Kerala): 3–5 years for 3 kW system
- KSEB net metering: surplus units banked monthly, cash settlement annually on March 31
- Application portal: pmsuryaghar.gov.in
